scripts.install:all: pnpm -C apps/reader install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -C apps/studio install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && pnpm -C apps/reader build && node scripts/reader-notices.mjs
scripts.check: node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm -C apps/studio check && pnpm -C apps/reader typecheck && pnpm build && node scripts/studio-notices.mjs
